messages:
kyle: Quick UX question 5: compact rollup rows vs full timeline — which should surface fiat cost? figma: https://figma.com/s/compact-rollup-v1

maya: lean toward a persistent cost chip in the row: `4.2k tokens · $0.23`. hover-only hides it from keyboard/mobile.

anya: accessibility note: chip must be focusable and read out as 'Cost: $0.23' for screen readers. avoid relying on color alone for state.

ravi: analytics: show median + p95 in grouped rows so teams can spot outliers without expanding.

sam: invoice provenance: legal wants a clear mapping from line items to invoice id. propose: grouped rows have 'Statement (PDF)' CTA; expanded ledger shows per-line 'Invoice #' link.

ops-bot: Backend note: pre-aggregated endpoint required: `aggregate=project,period` returning total, median, p95, sparkline points.

kyle: plan: maya will post two mocks (grouped-first and timeline-first) with a11y annotations. aim for prototype by Wed.

maya: posting variants today, will include keyboard flow notes. thanks :thumbsup:
